findings.source_quote: This is an artichoke plant, a member of the thistle family. Many people use this “thistle,” along with its cousin, the Cardoon, for food.

findings.source_quote: Think about it: Blessed Thistle, Milk Thistle, Teasel, Raspberry Leaf, and Blackberry roots are only a few examples of members of these “thorny weeds” used for medicinal and other food benefits.

findings.translation_quote: Cultivamos a alcachofra por suas folhas amargas, que são usadas para fazer amargos digestivos. Pense nisso: Blessed Thistle, Milk Thistle, Teasel, folha de framboesa e raízes de amora são apenas alguns exemplos de integrantes dessas “ervas espinhosas” usadas para fins medicinais e outros benefícios alimentares.
